description: 충청북도_지역하천 통계정보 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청북도. 충청북도 지역하천 통계정보는 지역명, 채수 지점번호, 하천명과 함께 전월 대비 변화량을 제공하는 Open API로, 하천 수질지표의 변동성을 월 단위로 파악할 수 있는 통계 활용가능. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
